evidence.integration_callers_note: L3 not claimed. The only caller of validate_physics_csv is the in-repo pilot driver scripts/pv_pilot_ex1_kcs.py. The physics CSV path is NOT registered as a quality profile (tensordata/quality/profiles/__init__.py registers GENERAL/TABULAR only), so the product surface POST /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/quality-checks cannot reach it, and grep over /root/ship-performance-platform, /srv/tensor/workspace/ship-performance-platform and /srv/tensor/ship-workspace/ship-performance-platform for validate_physics_csv|tensordata.quality|physics_csv returns no hits. Gradeable at L3 if the board accepts a same-repo driver consuming real platform exports as an integration caller; it is a one-row UPDATE away.
evidence.external_anchor: NONE for validator accuracy: the scenario is data-quality acceptance, and no towing-tank (EFD) baseline is in scope — declared in pilot_report.json scenario.limits[4] and recorded as accepted_limitation in artifacts/pv-pilot/ex1_kcs/failure_records.json. The one anchor-like comparison in the pilot (Holtrop wetted-surface S vs published value, -3.35%) belongs to the input data, not to the validator.
evidence.level_reason: L2 (implemented + independently verified implementation): real deterministic input->compute->output path over the platform's real EX1/KCS exports, committed code, 96/96 tests, run artifacts sha256-pinned, and an independent reviewer re-ran the declared command (exit 0). L3 withheld for lack of an external integration caller (see integration_callers_note). L4 (cross-validated) withheld: no EFD/analytic anchor exists for this scenario's accuracy, and the receipt itself records 'no EFD baseline: model accuracy is out of scope'. The review receipt contains no `level` field, so this level was derived by applying the platform maturity rubric (L1 tests / L2 impl_files+entry+run_artifacts / L3 +integration_callers / L4 +external anchor) to the receipt's own evidence; the basis is stated here so the board can regrade without re-running anything.
